def process(climate_clean, malta_top_sample):
    target_year = malta_top_sample['date'].iloc[0]  # 6412 (years BP)
    # Age_ky is in kiloyears BP, so convert target to ky
    target_ky = target_year / 1000.0  # 6.412 ky
    
    # Get rows with valid Age_ky and Al values
    df = climate_clean[['Age_ky', 'Al']].dropna(subset=['Age_ky'])
    
    # Find absolute difference to target
    df = df.copy()
    df['diff'] = (df['Age_ky'] - target_ky).abs()
    
    min_diff = df['diff'].min()
    closest = df[df['diff'] == min_diff]
    
    max_al = closest['Al'].max()
    
    return pd.DataFrame({
        'target_year_BP': [target_year],
        'target_ky': [target_ky],
        'min_diff': [min_diff],
        'closest_Age_ky': [closest['Age_ky'].tolist()],
        'max_Al': [round(max_al, 4)]
    })

    target_bp = malta_top_sample['date'].iloc[0]
    target_ky = target_bp / 1000.0
    
    df = climate_clean[['Age_ky', 'Al']].dropna(subset=['Age_ky', 'Al'])

    min_diff = diff.min()
